project_info.theme: Free registration call for a France study pathway after graduation
project_info.color_palette: Cream, Navy Blue, Red, Soft Paris Beige

main_subject.detail: A travel-themed promotional poster built from layered cream paper shapes over a blurred Paris street background, featuring a tilted photo of the Eiffel Tower and a central callout inviting free registration for a France study pathway leading to intake in January 2027.
main_subject.style: Soft travel-admissions poster with paper collage layers, rounded CTA buttons, and romantic Paris postcard treatment.

composition_elements.text:
VFE VIETNAM FRANCE EXCHANGE
DU HỌC PHÁP
HƯỚNG ĐI MỚI SAU TỐT NGHIỆP
Từ con số 0 đến giảng đường Pháp
Đăng ký tham gia MIỄN PHÍ
Nhận lộ trình Du học Pháp ngay T1/2027 dù chưa biết tiếng Pháp
Hà Nội: 14h00, ngày 20/06/2026
TP. HCM: 9h00, ngày 21/06/2026
ĐĂNG KÝ NGAY
items: Top Left: VFE logo on a white rounded label.
Top Right: Soft Paris street blur with upper paper layers and cream panel edges.
Bottom Left: Red rounded CTA 'ĐĂNG KÝ NGAY' and a tilted photo of the Eiffel Tower.
Bottom Right: Paris postal stamp doodle in sepia line style.
Center/Background: Large layered cream paper stack with headline 'DU HỌC PHÁP HƯỚNG ĐI MỚI SAU TỐT NGHIỆP', navy sub-pill 'Từ con số 0 đến giảng đường Pháp', and red-white free registration badge.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm romantic blur in the Paris street background, crisp paper edges, and polished social-ad CTA contrast.

Technical style: photo-collage admissions campaign poster, soft travel-poster daylight, polished CTA clarity, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
